Hi Soma — quick reply with what we need to move forward. TL;DR: we can do escrow but need a few approvals; tax reporting depends on which legal entity receives funds.

1) Tax / forms (required before we release funds):
   - If the receiving payee is a US person/entity (EIN on file), Redwood issues 1099-NEC for services paid >= $600. We require a completed W-9 (or the corporate equivalent) on file.
   - If the receiving payee is a foreign entity, we require a completed W-8BEN-E (or relevant W-8) and may apply withholding depending on treaty/status.
   - If payments are routed through a third-party escrow agent that will be the payee of record, Redwood will need a W-9 from that escrow entity (or W-8 if foreign) so we can comply with year-end reporting.

2) Escrow/process items:
   - We can support escrow as a payment routing option but Legal needs to pre-approve the escrow vendor (SecureHold) and see the escrow agreement.
   - Redwood requires the escrow agreement to state the payee of record and designate whether funds will be disbursed to Omega Cloud or to a nominated third party upon acceptance.
   - If SecureHold is acting purely as an agent (disbursing to Omega Cloud EIN), tax reporting flows to Omega. If SecureHold will keep funds and invoice as the payee, tax reporting may be issued to SecureHold unless we receive a valid W-9/W-8 from Oasis.

Next steps I recommend:
- Please confirm the legal entity name and EIN we should use for onboarding (copy of signed W-9 or W-8BEN-E). I attached a sample W-9 to speed things up (sample_w9_redwood.pdf).
- Share the proposed escrow agreement and SecureHold entity info (FEIN/EIN or tax classification).
- If you prefer e-consent for receiving a 1099 (i.e., confirm you accept year-end 1099 reporting rather than receiving a tax form), sign the DocuSign we can send; otherwise we’ll request the formal W-9/W-8 for the AP file.

I’ll loop in Legal if SecureHold is the proposed escrow provider so we can fast-track approval.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake

Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending SecureHold info. Summary / recommended routing: 

- If SecureHold disburses to your UK subsidiary (Omega Cloud Services Ltd): Redwood will consider the UK entity the payee of record. We would need the UK entity’s tax residency evidence (W-8BEN-E is correct) and documentation that SecureHold is acting as agent. Generally, Redwood does not withhold if valid W-8BEN-E is on file and treaty benefits apply — but our tax team will confirm after reviewing the W-8 and the final escrow agreement.

- If SecureHold disburses to your US branch (EIN on file): we will treat that US branch as the payee and will expect a completed W-9. Redwood will issue 1099-NEC to the receiving US EIN if payments meet the reporting threshold.

Escrow checklist for Redwood Legal (please provide):
- SecureHold LLC (EIN 27-1429931) corporate docs and W-9 (if they will be payee of record).
- Draft escrow agreement with payee-of-record clearly specified and disbursement trigger language that matches the pilot acceptance criteria.
- Contact and bank details for wire instructions (SecureHold or Omega, whichever will be the disbursement account).

I’ll have Legal confirm the vendor within 24 hours of receiving the escrow agreement. For now, PAUSE on the wire until we have the signed escrow agreement and the relevant tax form(s) in our AP file. Once Legal signs off on SecureHold, we can do a conditional release based on acceptance criteria.

Let me know if you’d like us to send the DocuSign for e-consent to receive a 1099 for the US branch — that can speed year-end paperwork if you prefer.

Thanks — Jordan
